name: Vis and Komiža
description: The furthest inhabited island off the coast, and shut to foreigners until 1989 for the same reason as Lastovo. Komiža on the west side is a fishing town with a Venetian tower in the harbour, and Stiniva cove is round the corner through a gap in the cliff.
getting: Ferry from Split, two hours twenty, or the fast catamaran in half that with no cars. Stiniva is a steep twenty-minute scramble down, or a five-minute boat ride from Komiža.
